local.upstream_line_endings: CRLF; reconstructable from normalized text with verified upstream SHA-256 and CRC32
local.preprocessing: UTF-8 source with line endings normalized to LF for repository storage; numeric tokens and all rows preserved. No filtering, clipping, normalization, fit or deembedding.
local.product_level: Processed displayed Fig3c experimental magnitude; not raw complex time records
local.role: Exposed exploratory readout-domain diagnostic, not independent validation or holdout

calibration.working_point: Set III, linked to Fig3c by main caption
calibration.uncertainty: Not supplied as a joint error/deembedding packet in inspected table; rounded central values only
calibration.use: Dimensionless ideal real-port amplitude-domain calculation only. Frequency units cancel in ratio; no detuning values used in a physical residual.

locators: Fig3 caption and Connecting experiment, model and stability analysis: Fig3c at low power, parameter Set III
Pulsed measurement: 1.4 s pulse, last 2 ms complex average, 0.8 s equilibration
method.stationarity_support: Authors identify Fig3c as a single stable fixed-point regime throughout; acquisition method supports steady-state intent. Not an independently quantified per-record stationarity/averaging error bound.
method.relative_power: Single nominal-power sweep; input photon flux varies with photon energy unless source power frequency dependence is traced. Not used here.
method.detuning_unit: Header says detuning Delta without unit; normalized-axis correspondence must be verified before any dimensional residual is scored.

follow_up_method_review.scope: Section III.1 circle-fitting method explicitly includes gain/phase/delay and impedance mismatch; section VIII.2 mean-field simulation omits explicit noise.
follow_up_method_review.boundary: Method existence and noiseless mean-field simulation do not identify exact-curve measurement-noise/gain uncertainties. No preprint values or quality-factor identity adopted. Illustrative calibration state is not substituted for Set III.

gain_envelope_diagnostic.model: reported amplitude m_i=g*t_i+e_i; one g>0, independently variable t_i in closed central ideal range [l,1]
gain_envelope_diagnostic.role: optimistic necessary range-enclosure test, not calibration, cavity fit, physical rejection or statistical noise estimate
gain_envelope_diagnostic.policy: No computed envelope optimizer is applied as gain correction. Unknown physical uncertainty and complex mismatch remain open; all rows retained.

decision.purpose: Check pointwise compatibility with the CENTRAL ideal transfer domain, not physical acceptance/rejection
decision.policy: Keep all rows and report outside-domain counts. Do not clip, select compatible rows after seeing residuals, infer a noise law from neighboring detunings, or reuse this exposed curve as blind validation.
